Name: Aegipan
Description:
"Black Bengal" breed of goats is indigenous to the eastern part of the Indian subcontinent. Their meat is supposed to be the best quality of chevon (goat meat) in the entire world. However, this high demand for its meat has led the local goat farmers to castrate the male kids. Doing so at an early age ensures higher weight and removes offensive meat odour – giving the farmers higher income. This has now resulted in a situation wherein it has become difficult (and even impossible, in certain areas) to source any adult male goat for breeding. 

The scientific solution to this problem is Artificial Insemination (AI). 

However, our country lacks any organised private sector intervention in this field. And it is precisely this particular vacant marketplace that Aegipan has pioneered to fill-in with its niche market offerings. Having commenced its journey in 2018, Aegipan has been able not only to establish the financial viability of its unique business offerings but has also been recognized time and again for its pioneering effort by institutions of national importance – Indian Council of Agriculture Research (ICAR), Central Institute for Research on Goats (CIRG), National Dairy Research Institute (NDRI), Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Calcutta, Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC) and so on.

Name: 6th World Congress on Biotechnology

The department consists of 17 faculties with diverse research backgrounds, engaged in teaching and research in applied biological sciences and biomedical engineering. he department frequently receives grants from various central funding agencies such as DST, DBT, CSIR to support research activities. It is equipped with extensive research facilities and infrastructure to develop cutting-edge technology through interdisciplinary research, training, and technical innovation.
The major thrust of the department includes:
Cell and Molecular Biotechnology
Plant Biotechnology
Immunology and Infection Biology
Bioprocess Engineering
Food Biotechnology
Microbial and Environmental Biotechnology
Computational Biology and Bioinformatics
Drug Delivery and Nano Biotechnology
The Department currently offers the following academic programs-
•           BTech in Biotechnology (4 years)
•           BTech-MTech Dual degree in Biotechnology (5 years)
•           MTech in Biotechnology (2 years)
•           MSc in Life Sciences (2 years)
•           Doctor of philosophy (PhD) program
Since commencement, the department has consistently performed well. Students have already made their mark in higher education and in the professional world in India and abroad. Some of the Industry students are placed in are Tata Consultancy, Capegemini,  Infosys, while students have opted for higher studies in some of the reputed Institutes like  IITs, IIMs, University of Queensland, Wisconsin Madison etc. They routinely get selected for summer internships in the best academic institutes in India and abroad. They also get selected in prestigious programs such as the PMRF fellowship, Khorana Program, KVPY fellowship, Indian Academy of Science fellowship etc.
